english: Hm-hm-hm♪ ...Huh?\nWhat's wrong?
I'm doing the dishes right now,\nso if you need something, could it wait?
The dishes for that many people?
Yes. Someone else cooked,\nso I figured I'd at least\ndo the dishes.
Isn't that tough?
Originally, at my family home... Hoshiga Shrine,\nthere were lots of family members.
By the way, I'm the eldest\nof seven sisters.
So this many dishes is\neveryday stuff for me. I'm used to it.\nJapanese food uses a lot of dishes, too.
Should I help?
What's with the sudden offer?\nCould you have some ulterior motive...
(Ugh, I finally worked up the motivation...)
Th-that's not it at all!
But your flustered reaction is suspicious...
There's really nothing...
I just purely wanted to help.
I-I see...\nSorry for suspecting you...!
I've been hearing things from everyone,\nso I got a little worried...
Like you have no delicacy,\nor, um... peeping suspicions...
I have no memory of that...
Hah! I-I'm so sorry!\nHow rude of me...!
No, it's fine...
Then, could you wipe the rinsed dishes\nwith a cloth?
This cloth is for the first wipe,\nand that one's for the finishing wipe.
Understood.\nDo you always work this carefully?
Carefully...?\nI've never really thought about it.
When I think about doing it for someone,\nit just feels natural to do it this way.\nThat's what I think.
And if they're happy,\nthat makes me very happy too.
(She's a good person...\nShe's probably a kind big sister at home too.)
Your hands have stopped, is something wrong?
If you're not feeling well, you don't\nhave to force yourself to help.
Ah, sorry. Just thinking...
(She's a Butei too, but\nshe's nothing like Aria-san...\nI can't picture her swinging a gun around...)
Out for a walk?
Something like that.\n...You're not in uniform today.
Yes, I thought I'd move my body a bit.\nI need to train now and then,\nor my skills will get rusty.
Ah, if you'd like,\ncould you help me a little?
If you could wrap these straw bundles around\nthis bamboo and hold them, it'd help.
(One, two, three... so many of them,\nwhere was she keeping all these?)
What's wrong?\nStaring at the straw and bamboo...\nIs it that unusual?
Ah, you're wondering what I'm making.\nThese are materials for training makiwara.
Combined, they're about as hard as a human body,\nmaking them great training targets.
(That's not what I wanted to know...\nAlso, that was a casually scary thing to say...)
They've used these since long ago\nfor iaijutsu and naginata training.
(...Ah, she meant generally. Good...)
Ah, that's right! Since you're here,\nwould you like to join me?
I wouldn't want to intrude...
N-no, not at all!\nBut thank you for your consideration.
...Right, you don't really\nlike fighting, do you?
It's not really my strong suit...
I-I'm sorry!\nRight, you don't really\nlike fighting...
Sorry for inviting you so forcefully...
No, it's fine. Don't worry about it.
Thank you.
Now... in... out...
Fufu... ufufu... hahahaha!
Hm?
Thief cats will be eliminated at once!!
Wh-what!?
Divine punishment! Divine punishment!!\nDivine punishmeent!!
(Weird battle cry... kind of scary...)
Not done yeeet!!
Wh-what! A huge gun!?\nWhere did that come from...
Ah, this gun?\nThis is a belt-fed machine gun.\nIt's very powerful.
(That's not what I wanted to know!)
Haaaaah!
Eeeek!
Phew! That felt great!\nWorked up a good sweat.
Thank you for helping with the makiwara prep.
N-no, no, don't mention it...
(So Shirayuki-san is a Butei too...\nI should be careful not to anger her...)
Will you help me with training\nagain?
I'm sorry to ask.\nBut prepping makiwara alone is tough,\nso it really helps.
No, I've just got free time. Don't worry about it.
Still, thank you.
Phew... I think that's about it.
Thanks for your hard work.\nWell, I'll be going...
Yes! Thank you,\nas always.
Thanks to you, I can prep more makiwara\nthan I could alone,\nand training is going great!
(Every time, I wonder\nhow she prepares these materials?)
Well, see you later...
Yes!
Ah, maybe I should help clean up too.\nCleaning up those remains looks tough.\nYeah, let's do that.
Shirayuki-san, I'll help with the cleanup...
!? No!\nNot right now!?
!? Y-you were changing...!\nI-I'm sorry...
...been...
Seen... by a man...\nAnd not even by someone I like...!\n...by someone other than the one in my dream...!
Shirayuki...san...?
...You saw, didn't you?
That I, the model student council president,\nwas secretly wearing black panties...\n...You saw, didn't you?
I-I didn't see...!
(Th-this atmosphere...)
I can't let you escape\nanymore...!
But... you did help me...\nso I'll give you a choice.
This machine gun or the kusarigama,\nwhich do you prefer?
I-I'm sorry!\nI didn't mean anything by it...!
...Apologizing honestly is\na very good thing...
But it's too late...!
If possible, I'd rather have neither...!
Fufu... how selfish.\nFor someone so selfish, you'll get both!
Now, prepaaare yourself!!
Gyaaaaah!
(I should've just gone home...)
Wh-what is it!? Even if you say you came\nto apologize for last time,\nI can't believe you!!
Just like everyone said,\nyou really are a pervert!
You're probably thinking, if you're lucky,\nmaybe again... something lewd,\naren't you!
(Terrible things to say... everyone else is terrible too...)
Don't come near me!\nIf you come any closer...\nI'll scream!
W-wait, Shirayuki-san!
D-don't say my name!\nAnd don't come near me!
I-it's over for me...\nI might as well bite my tongue while I'm still pure...!
I really came to apologize!\nI came back to help clean up and it was coincidence...!
Huh? R-really?\nB-but, you stared at my... my\nunderwear...!
I-it was very beautiful!\nThe contrast of black underwear on white skin...
C-contrast...!?
So you did see...!\nThoroughly, with lewd eyes!
(Oops, my compliment backfired...!)
I-I didn't see!
R-really...?
Y-yes! I wasn't thinking about how little fabric there was!
So you WERE looking!
Th-then, before I'm the one taken out,\nI'll silence you after all...!
Eep!\nSorry sorry sorry!\nSpare my life...!
I-I wouldn't kill anyone!\nI may not look it, but I'm a Butei too!
H-huh, but...
I'll arrest you for a minor offense\nand detain you so you can't talk\nabout my underwear!
My life is spared, but please spare me that too!
N-no! I can't rest easy until\nI have proof you've reformed!
I won't tell anyone, and I'll do anything,\nso please forgive me...!
Really...?\nYou really won't tell anyone?
Yes! About the black underwear thing...
…I'm still worried, though.
I'll be keeping an eye on you for a while!\nIf you make any funny moves,\nI'll arrest you on the spot!
Don't even think about running!\nI'll divine it with my miko fortune slips\nand hunt you down!
(So fortune-telling can do that, too…)
W-well, fine, then!
Y-yes…!
(I've gotten into something weird again…)
N-no matter what you say,\nI'm not calling off the surveillance!
So just give up!\nAnd don't come any closer than that!
E-even so… I'll do anything,\nso can't you call off the surveillance?\nIt's causing me all sorts of trouble…
N-no!\nYou peeked at a maiden's secret,\nso you'll just have to put up with it!
Otherwise, I'm turning you over to the police!
I really won't tell a soul…\nWhat do I have to do to make you believe me…?
…If you could show me some sincerity-\nenough that I could trust you…
M-money?
N-no! I mean, show it through your actions!
Like what, for example?
Well… it comes down to whether\nyou can act for other people's sake.
Um, off the top of my head…\nmaybe preparing everyone's meals,\nor something like that?
I'll do it!
…That was instant. I might have to rethink you a little.
That's all it takes?\nOf course I'll do it, but…
'That's all'?! Meals are important, you know!
A balanced diet is essential\nfor staying healthy!
And the iron rule for winning over the one you love\nis to capture their stomach first!\nMy slogan is: 'Feeding them takes patience!'
(Something about the mood here…)
Ahem… Well then, let's get started.\nPlease help with the meal prep.
I'll peel the potatoes, so could you\ntake care of removing the eyes?
They cause food poisoning,\nso make sure none are left behind.
Yes.
…Hm-hm-hmmm♪
You look like you're having fun.
Oh, was I being loud?\nSorry about that.
I just started picturing how happy everyone will be\nwhen they see the finished dishes,\nand I got all excited…
Everyone calls me their friend…
Doing things for your friends being this much fun-\nI only learned that when I came along with everyone.
So when I thought about doing this for them,\nI just couldn't help it…
By the way, do I count as one of them?
Peeping toms are still under review!
Figured as much…
'How long will this helping go on?'\nis that it?
Like I said before-\nuntil I feel I can trust you.
Well then, shall we start today's\ncooking prep?
I'll fillet the fish, so please\npeel the vegetables.
Yes.
Oh, and especially with the potatoes…
What was it again?
The eyes are poisonous, so be careful\nnot to leave any behind.
…I told you that last time,\nbut I guess you forgot.
Sorry…
Potato eyes are poisonous, so don't leave any.\nI've got it memorized now.
You're a quick study. That helps a lot.
Huh? This fish is a little tough…\nHeave… ho.
Ow! Ugh… I cut my index finger…
Are you okay? Heal!
Th-thank you…
But it's not a serious cut…\nyou didn't have to waste a Heal on me…
Besides, if I wanted to,\nI could heal it myself…
I heard using your shrine maiden powers tires you out.\nMine barely costs me anything.
…You're not so bad after all.\nI might have to rethink you a little.
Phew, looks like that's everything.\nGood work today.
Good work.
Also, there's one more thing.\nYour helping duties end today.
I've realized you're not someone who'd hurt anyone\non purpose-you just lack attentiveness and tact.
R-really?!
But if you breathe a word of it…
I-I know…
(Looks like she's forgiven me…\nI feel like we're closer than before, too,\nso it all worked out in the end…)
(But I'll make sure never to go near\nShirayuki-san while she's changing…)
W-what's the matter?\nYou don't have to help out anymore!
Actually, I'm in the middle of something,\nso could you please not come in…?
S-sorry, while you're changing!\nI guess helping out just became a habit…
Oh, no, that's not it…
Then what are you doing?
I'd rather you didn't see it, so to speak…\nWh-what-KYAAAH!!
Don't peek in while I'm in the middle\nof saying that!
Honestly! You have NO tact at all!
I-I couldn't help it…\nAnyway, there's a lot of cloth here.\nAre you, like, making clothes?
Th-this is…!
Want me to help?
That's kind of you, but the thought is enough…\nBesides, if there were something I could ask you\nto do, I'd have said so already…
And stop staring so hard!\nEven I'm going to get mad at this rate!
What are you making?
That's exactly why I'm telling you not to look-\nI don't want to tell you!
Even in a case like this, it's still a violation\nof the Minor Offenses Act, you know!
S-sorry…\nBut I won't tell anyone, so don't worry.
That's not even the point!
I don't want this work seen!
Ah! It's nothing!\nForget everything you just saw.
I'll resume the work somewhere else,\nso don't get in my way next time…
Ah, Shirayuki-san… she's gone.
(The clothes she didn't want me to see…?\nWhat could they be, I wonder)
(Could it be a thank-you for the Heal the other day?\nSurely not…)
Huh? Where is this?\nLooks like a school, but one I've never seen.\nAnd it's so lively.
…Th-this way!
That voice-Shirayuki-san. Is this the classroom?\nThere's a sign… 'Cafe SHC'?
Really, you mustn't be late.
(White blouse and a tight skirt,\nblack-framed glasses… Th-there's a teacher!)
If you're late again, you'll be standing\nin the hallway, understood?
(She's really getting into the role…)
Well? Your reply?
Y-yes, Shirayuki-sensei…
Yes, what a nice reply!
(I see-the clothes she was making the other day\nwere for this…! Plain, but they really\nshow off her chest…)
Eep! D-don't stare at me like that…!
B-but! If you want to look…\nyou can look… as much as you like…!
Wh-what?! N-no, the menu!\nShow me the menu, please!
The menu is a special parfait,\ntea… and shortcake.
Or maybe… me…?!
-! Th-the parfait! Parfait, please!
Coming right up…!
Sorry to keep you waiting. One special parfait!
I-it looks delicious. Thank you for the food.
Wait. I'll… feed it to you!
(No way…!)
Here, say ahh! Ah!\nSorry, I spilled it.\nI have to wipe it off…
(Th-the whipped cream's on her chest and skirt…)
Oh, what a shame… the bell rang.
But if you'd like to continue…\nwould you like to… extend…?
E-extend, what…?!
'Extend'? What on earth are you dreaming about?
Huh? Where is this…?\nShirayuki-san's in uniform too…
Huh? I have been all along…
That's weird… cosplay Shirayuki-san\nwas saying 'the menu is me' or something…
Ehh?! I never said that!\nStop having weird dreams!
A-a dream? Then the clothes\nShirayuki-san was making the other day…
Th-that was just me mending\neveryone else's clothes!
Everyone said they don't want a peeping tom like you\nseeing their clothes or underwear…
Besides, I told you to forget it,\ndidn't I?!
I-I see… so that's why you didn't want\nme of all people to see it…
(It was… all a dream…)
